facts.business: Modi Rubber Limited is a company that previously operated in multiple jurisdictions but has had its operations closed since August 2001 due to illegal strikes, and is now pursuing a joint venture in the salon and beauty business under the Marco Aldany brand while also seeking to amend its object clause to include health, beauty, and wellness services.

auditor.name: P N A M & CO. LLP

key_risks: Evaluation of contingencies & uncertain tax positions

Prior to closure of operations by illegal strikes of the workers in August 2001, the Company operated in multiple jurisdictions and subjected to periodic challenges by local tax authorities, income tax authorities, labour law authorities & other statutory authorities on a range of various tax & other matters during the normal course of business.
facts.related_party_note: Modi Marco Aldany Private Limited (MMAPL) was incorporated pursuant to a joint venture arrangement between Modi Rubber Limited (MRL) and Alma Beauty Corporation S.L., Spain (Alma Beauty), with both parties holding 50% each in the said joint venture company.
